purpose: Teach: 丸太/水色/土手/浜辺/ウロコ/ニオイ/吊り/ハズレ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、林間学校で丸太運んでたな
lines.en: Riku — you were carrying those logs at the school camp, weren't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing drawl. Eyes bright with mischief. Not quite a question, more of a playful accusation. Short pause after his name to let it land.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、水色のジャージ気に入ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were all about that light-blue jersey, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Casual counter-volley, a small smile in the voice. Soft on her name — not quite warm, but the warmth is there if you listen. Even pace, unbothered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、土手でランニングしてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were doing those runs down by the riverbank, right?
lines.style: Following the game now. Slightly faster delivery. Genuine curiosity behind the teasing. The kind of attention that means she was watching too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で浜辺行ってたろ、桜
lines.en: Your family went to the beach, didn't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Mirror-image ease. Steady rhythm, no strain. Slight lightness on the memory itself — not caught, just noting. Direct eye-contact in tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、料理で魚のウロコ取り苦戦してたな
lines.en: Riku — you were really struggling with those fish scales in cooking class.
lines.style: Smirk audible now. Shorter, snappier attack. The memory is a small gift and a small tease wrapped together. Slight emphasis on the struggle.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新しい靴のニオイ気にしてたな、桜
lines.en: You kept noticing the smell of your new shoes, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry mirror. Quicker tempo, pleased with himself. Slight sing-song quality without being mocking — he caught something she tried to hide. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部室の吊り棚直してたな
lines.en: Riku — you were fixing that hanging shelf in the club room.
lines.style: Shift: smaller observation, less teasing edge. Quieter. Noting something practical and kind. The game continues but the tone softens slightly — she noticed him noticing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祭りのくじでハズレばっかだったろ、桜
lines.en: You kept losing every single lottery ticket at the festival, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final volley. Quick, playful close with affection underneath. Warmth blooming now. The teasing has always been fondness — and he's letting her know he sees that too.
